subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin believes Stone Giants don’t move and are taciturn to a fault.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin remembered that the Duergars are literal people but was uncertain how to continue.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin asked about crazy people in the city.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin described behavior that doesn’t follow orders and brings certain doom without profit.

subject: Thorin's home
fact: Thorin wants to understand the nature of Stone Giants, but his own origins or motivations for seeking them are not specified.

subject: Thorin

subject: Thorin

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin remembered that Stone Giants are not talkative and may take a long time to initiate conversation.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin asked about stone giants he had heard of.

subject: Thorin

subject: Thorin
